meta.title: Enshrine 欣奉 — Pets Afterlife Services | Pet Cremation & Columbarium Singapore
meta.description: Enshrine delivers dignified pet afterlife services in Singapore — private cremation, celebrant & religious services, sea scattering, and the first freehold pet columbarium at 47 Lorong 16 Geylang.

hero.paragraph: Enshrine commits to deliver dignified afterlife services to your dearly departed, catering to every family's needs and concerns — so you can grieve, remember, and say goodbye with grace.
hero.imageAlt: A cat and dog resting peacefully together

about.lead: We understand how distressing it is to lose a beloved companion. Let Enshrine handle all the arrangements and hold the space for you to grieve and bid your final farewell. From cremation and sea burial to columbarium, keepsakes and religious services — every detail is cared for with dignity.

services.lead: A complete pets afterlife service — cremation, sea burial, columbarium, keepsakes and religious rites — delivered with trust, respect, care and commitment.

cards.title: Private Pet Cremation
cards.desc: Single pet private cremation allows family and friends to bid their final farewell privately and witness the process throughout.
items: Optional bone picking, should you wish to personally inter your pet

cards.imageAlt: Pet celebrant service — final touch tribute with flowers
cards.title: Pet Celebrant Service
cards.desc: A 30-minute prayer and eulogy session conducted with Final Touch, Tribute and Final Farewell — honouring the bond you shared.
items: Religious options: Buddhist, Taoist, Christian & Catholic
Video montage capturing your pet's precious last moments

cards.imageAlt: Private sea scattering of pet cremains
cards.title: Private Sea Scattering
cards.desc: Send your beloved pet's cremains to nature personally, with an optional religious ritual during the sea scattering event.
items: Boat chartered solely for your family
Arrangements with the respective religious leader
Our advisors accompany and guide you throughout

cards.imageAlt: Columbarium niches with customised bamboo urns
cards.title: Columbarium & Keepsakes
cards.desc: After a dignified farewell, honour your pet who has crossed the rainbow bridge with a permanent resting place at our Geylang columbarium — or keep them close with a personalised keepsake.
items: Customised bamboo urns with photo, name & dates

religious.lead: We provide religious funeral services across four faiths, each conducted with the appropriate rites and reverence.

columbarium.badge: The First & Only Freehold Pet Columbarium in Singapore
columbarium.lead: More than just a resting place. Enshrine's newly built pet columbarium at 47 Lorong 16 Geylang is a freehold, four-storey building with more than 10,000 pet niches — fully air-conditioned for a quiet, comfortable and elegant ambiance.
columbarium.buildingImageAlt: Enshrine pet columbarium building at 47 Lorong 16 Geylang
features: Pets' play area on every level — bring your living pets along

gallery.imageAlt: Columbarium niche wall with feature lighting

rows.desc: Each single niche accommodates the ashes of one pet in a personalised, respectful memorial space. Covered with transparent material, it lets you see through to your beloved pet's urn directly. Every bamboo urn is customised with your pet's photo, name and dates — preserving a visual connection that brings comfort and solace during visits.

rows.imageAlt: Family pet niche wall with personalised plaques
rows.desc: Designed to accommodate the ashes of multiple pets — up to 32 — with no divider, so your pets stay together even in their afterlife, just as they were in life. A personalised plaque bearing your pets' individual photos or a customised family photo, with their names and dates, creates a lasting legacy that honours their memories together.
